h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panihati

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panihati

items.pText: A playground quotation can look simple, a list of items and a total, but two offers with the same items can mean very different things. Buyers in Panihati and the towns along the Hooghly north of Kolkata often send us a competing quote and ask why the prices differ. The answer is usually in the details the quote leaves out.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our own factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it. With every quote we send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Share your site size, the age group and photos, and we will prepare one for your school, club or society.

richText.heading: What to check in a playground quotation

items: Materials: whether the frames are galvanised steel and whether plastic parts are roto-moulded.
Installation: whether it is included, and whether the pieces are self-standing or grouted.
Warranty: what is covered and for how long, in writing.

c: Our warranty is three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. A quote should also say whether rubber flooring is included. Ask for a layout drawing, because it shows whether the equipment fits your ground with its safe play area. You can browse our

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Why do playground quotes from different suppliers vary so much?
items.a: Materials, installation and warranty are often not stated the same way. Compare galvanised against painted steel, check whether installation is included, and ask for the warranty in writing.

items.q: Does your quote include installation in Panihati?
items.a: We state installation clearly in every quote. Our installation team or a dealer in West Bengal installs the equipment after it is dispatched from Vasai.

items.q: Do you send a layout drawing with the quote?
items.a: Yes. The layout drawing shows where each piece goes and marks its safe play area, so you can check the fit before you approve anything.
